## ErrorDetailsByCode.TARGET_NOT_FOUND property

A singular target does not exist. When the target is an entry of an identity collection being resolved, `entryIndex` is that entry's zero-based position in the collection's entries.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly TARGET_NOT_FOUND: {
        readonly resource?: string;
        readonly entryIndex?: number;
    };
```
